name: Fair lending compliance program
description: Written program with named owners for fair lending testing and issue follow-up.

name: Benchmark replication exercise
description: Second-line analysts rebuild the model's headline results from raw data and reconcile any difference.

name: Legacy scorecard validation
description: Annual validation of the previous credit scorecard; closed when the scorecard was replaced.

name: AI risk assessment at intake
description: Risk team scores each new AI proposal for severity and likelihood before build starts.

name: Evaluation test suite
description: Standing set of metrics and test cases run against each chatbot and copilot before release and monthly in use.

name: Credit decision outcome watch
description: Monthly report of approval and decline rates by segment, reviewed for unexplained shifts.

name: Business owner inventory attestation
description: Each business owner signs that the entries for their area are correct and complete.

name: Branch cash handling audit
description: Quarterly count and reconciliation of cash held at branches, reviewed by the branch audit lead.

name: Workload roll-call
description: Each quarter the platform team counts the running AI workloads and ties each one to a business owner.

name: Chatbot answer sampling
description: Weekly sample of chatbot answers is read by a reviewer and scored for errors.

name: Model documentation standard
description: Template and review gate that requires design notes, assumptions and known limits before a model is approved.

name: Scoring service failure testing
description: Twice a year the scoring service is switched to its backup path and the results are compared with the primary.

name: Adversarial testing of the chatbot
description: Red-team exercise that tries to push the chatbot into unsafe or wrong answers.

name: Roles and responsibilities matrix review
description: Annual refresh of who owns, builds, validates and approves each AI system.

name: Second-line review of chatbots
description: Second-line reviewers test each new chatbot or copilot against its approved use before launch.

name: Developer pre-release self-check
description: Checklist the build team completes on its own work before release; it is not an independent validation.

name: Policy exception log
description: Exceptions to AI policy are logged, approved by a named executive and reviewed each quarter.

name: Vendor invoice approval
description: Finance reviews third-party invoices against purchase orders before payment is released.

name: Challenger comparison review
description: A separate team builds a simple alternative and compares its results with the production model.

name: Data center power resilience test
description: Annual test of generator and battery backup so critical services recover during a power cut.

name: Underwriter override log
description: Every manual override of an automated credit decision is recorded with the reason and the approver.

name: Model performance monitoring
description: Monthly dashboard of accuracy and drift for each model, with threshold breaches escalated to the owner.

name: Vendor model performance review
description: Annual comparison of a purchased model's results with the performance the vendor states.

name: Copilot prompt log
description: Prompts and answers from the internal copilot are stored with user and time for later checks.

name: AI risk register
description: Register of AI risks with an owner, severity rating and review date for every entry.

name: Vendor attestation collection
description: Annual signed statements from model vendors on testing, change notices and support terms.

name: Marketing material approval
description: Compliance sign-off on customer-facing marketing text, including notices and instructions on how to use each offer, before publication.

name: Access recertification
description: Quarterly review of who can log in to production systems and with which privileges.

name: Input data reconciliation
description: Monthly reconciliation of model input tables to the source ledgers, with differences logged.

name: Fraud score drift watch
description: Daily drift dashboard on the fraud model's score distribution, with an alert when it moves.

name: Network traffic monitoring
description: Continuous monitoring of network traffic across deployed production systems for signs of intrusion.

name: Outcomes back-testing
description: Quarterly comparison of model predictions with realized outcomes, with gaps investigated.

name: Model inventory register
description: Single list of every model and AI system in use, with owner, tier and status.

name: Human review of automated declines
description: A trained underwriter reviews a sample of automated declines and can override the outcome.

name: Late notice escalation
description: Any application nearing its notice deadline is flagged to the operations lead for same-day action.

name: Reason-code derivation memo
description: Memo signed by the model owner showing how each reason code follows from the scorecard inputs.

name: Population stability check
description: Monthly check that the applicants reaching the scorecard still look like the build population.

name: Model risk appetite review
description: Senior risk committee reviews each year whether model risk stays inside the stated appetite limits.

name: Credit application record retention
description: Credit application files and decision notices are kept for the period the bank has set.

name: Decision log retention
description: Immutable log of each automated decision with its inputs, output and model version, kept for the retention period.

name: Training data quality checks
description: Automated checks for gaps, duplicates and known errors in the data used to build and test models.

name: Exit plan review for model vendors
description: Annual check that each vendor-supplied model has a tested way out if the contract ends.

name: Fraud case notes
description: Analysts keep a note of why each fraud alert was closed or escalated, stored with the case.

name: Documentation completeness sampling
description: Second-line sample of model files checks that the required design notes are present and current.

name: Reason code mapping review
description: Annual review of the table that maps scorecard factors to the reason phrases shown to applicants.

name: Prompt register
description: Versioned record of the instructions given to each chatbot or copilot, with the approver and the date.

name: Employee conduct training
description: Annual training for staff on conduct, with policy acknowledgments and roles for reporting concerns.

name: Chat handoff to a human agent
description: Customers can reach a human agent at any point, and agents can stop the chatbot.

name: Application uptime monitoring
description: Alerts on response time and availability of customer applications against set thresholds, with escalation to the on-call engineer.

name: Customer data use approval
description: Approval board decides whether a new use of customer data is allowed and records the reason.

name: AI governance committee
description: Committee chaired by the chief risk officer approves AI policy, assigns roles and reviews exceptions quarterly.

name: Scorecard metrics review
description: Monthly pack of accuracy and stability metrics for the credit scorecard, reviewed by the model owner.

name: Model risk rating review
description: Model risk team assigns a rating to each model and sets how often it is reviewed.

name: Board reporting on AI use
description: Quarterly pack to the board risk committee on AI use, exceptions and open issues.

name: Source lineage catalog
description: Catalog showing the provenance of every data source, who approved its use and what changed since.

name: Adverse action reason review
description: Compliance samples declined applications each month and checks the stated reasons against the model's top factors.

name: Vendor model due diligence
description: Purchased models are assessed on onboarding and every year, with results filed by the model owner.

name: Chatbot reply keyword filter
description: Blocklist of words screened from chatbot replies; closed after the chatbot was rebuilt.

name: Notice timeliness report
description: Weekly report of days from decision to notice for every credit application, with late items escalated.

name: Annual model validation
description: Validation team, independent of development, tests each model before approval and every year after.
